UserProfileDoc.title: UserProfileDoc
UserProfileDoc.description: User cloud document storing synchronized profile, lists, watch history, likes, and settings

lists.description: Synchronized user custom lists and default watchlists

continueWatching.description: Synchronized continue watching items and timestamps

MediaComment.title: MediaComment
MediaComment.description: Global user comment on a movie, show, or anime title

mediaKey.description: Compound identifier for the media item, e.g. movie_315162 or tv_1396

uid.description: Firebase UID of the comment author

photoURL.description: Avatar image URL of the author

likesCount.description: Number of upvotes/likes on the comment

/users/{uid}.description: Private user state including lists, continue watching, likes, and settings, accessible only by owner

/media_comments/{commentId}.description: Public comments queryable by mediaKey and writeable by authenticated or verified users
